contracts.clause: (if not Pass_A and not Pass_B then Classify'Result = Neither)
(if Pass_A and not Pass_B then Classify'Result = A_Only)
(if not Pass_A and Pass_B then Classify'Result = B_Only)
(if Pass_A and Pass_B then Classify'Result = Both)
C.N00 = C'Old.N00 + (if E = Neither then 1 else 0)
C.N10 = C'Old.N10 + (if E = A_Only then 1 else 0)
C.N01 = C'Old.N01 + (if E = B_Only then 1 else 0)
C.N11 = C'Old.N11 + (if E = Both then 1 else 0)
(if Event in Simulation_Header_Event | Simulation_Row_Event then Column_Count'Result = 11)
(if Event in Calculations_Header_Event | Calculation_Row_Event | Infinite_Row_Event then Column_Count'Result = 4)
(if Event in No_Event | Options_Read | Examples_Header_Event then Column_Count'Result = 0)
(if Text'Length > 1 and then Text (Text'First) = '0' then not Decimal_Image'Result)
(if Lower_SF >= P and then Upper_SF <= P then Inverse_Bracket_Acceptable'Result)
(if Numeric_Format'Result then Digits_After = 12 or else Digits_After = 14)

(if U in 2.0 ** (-53) .. 1.0 - 2.0 ** (-53)
      and then Radius in 0.0 .. 9.0 then Radius_Acceptable'Result)
(Simulation_Payload'Result => (N, Trials, Mean, Variance, C, Rate_Two, Rate_Three, Expected_Two, Expected_Three))
(if Sqrt_Acceptable'Result then (if X <= 1.0 then Value <= 1.0) and then (if X >= 1.0E-6 then Value >= 0.0005))

(if Value >= 0.0
      and then (if X <= 1.0 then Value <= 1.0)
      and then (if X >= 1.0E-6 then Value >= 0.0005) then Sqrt_Acceptable'Result)

Transition'Result.Section =
         (case Event is
            when Simulation_Header_Event => Simulation,
            when Calculations_Header_Event => Calculations,
            when Examples_Header_Event => Examples,
            when others => Trace.Section)
(if Valid_Column_Label'Result then (for all C of Label => C /= ',' and then C /= ASCII.LF and then C /= ASCII.CR))
(if Label'Length > 0 and then (for all C of Label => C /= ',' and then C /= ASCII.LF and then C /= ASCII.CR) then Valid_Column_Label'Result)
C.Above_Rare = C.Above_Rare'Old + (if Z > Rare_Cutoff then 1 else 0)
(if Valid'Result then C.Above_Three <= C.Above_Two and then C.Above_Two <= C.Total)
(if C.Above_Rare <= C.Above_Three and then C.Above_Three <= C.Above_Two and then C.Above_Two <= C.Total then Valid'Result)

for all K in Values'Range =>
       Values (K).Joint in 0.0 .. 4.0 * Long_Float (I - 1) and
       Values (K).Marginal in 0.0 .. 4.0 * Long_Float (I - 1)
(for all K in Values'Range => Values (K).Joint in 0.0 .. 4.0 * Long_Float (I))
(for all K in Values'Range => Values (K).Marginal in 0.0 .. 4.0 * Long_Float (I))
(Value => (Weight, X, Y, Cutoff, Value), null => I)
((for all K in Basic_Grid'Result'Range => Basic_Grid'Result (K).Marginal in 0.0 .. 1.0))

(for all K in Values'Range =>
          Values (K).Joint in 0.0 .. Total and Values (K).Marginal in 0.0 .. Total)
((Report_Output, Trace) => (N, Factor, Z, Score, Report_Output, Trace))

Trace = Hoeflin_Boundary_Models.Transition (Trace'Old, Hoeflin_Boundary_Models.Simulation_Row_Event, Hoeflin_Boundary_Models.Simulation_Payload (N, Trials, Mean, Variance, C, Rate_Two, Rate_Three, Expected_Two, Expected_Three))
((Report_Output, Trace) => (N, Trials, Mean, Variance, C, Rate_Two, Rate_Three, Expected_Two, Expected_Three, Report_Output, Trace))
(if Conditional_Normal_Return'Result then M in 1 .. Scale and then J = Old_J and then M = Old_M and then J <= M)

(if J in 0 .. Scale and then M in 1 .. Scale
       and then J = Old_J and then M = Old_M and then J <= M then Conditional_Normal_Return'Result)
(if X <= 1.0E-9 and then Y in 0.0 .. 1.0001 then Exp_Normal_Return'Result)
(if After = Before and then After <= 1.0E-9 then Exponent_Normal_Return'Result)
(if Grid_Cell_Normal_Return'Result then Joint in 0.0 .. Total and then Marginal in 0.0 .. Total)

(if Total in 1.0E-100 .. 1.0E6 and then
       Joint in 0.0 .. Total and then Marginal in 0.0 .. Total then Grid_Cell_Normal_Return'Result)
(if Joint_Normal_Return'Result then B in 0.0 .. 1.0 and then J = Old_J and then J in 0.0 .. A and then J <= B)

(if A in 0.0 .. 1.0 and then B in 0.0 .. 1.0
       and then J = Old_J and then J in 0.0 .. A and then J <= B then Joint_Normal_Return'Result)
(if X in 4.0E-10 .. 0.9999999999 and then Y in -23.0 .. 0.0 then Log_Normal_Return'Result)
(if After = Before and then After in 0.0 .. 0.96 then Node_Normal_Return'Result)
Union_Normal_Return (A, B, J, Old_A, Old_B, Old_J)
(if After = Before and then After in 0.0 .. 1.0 then Probability_Normal_Return'Result)
(if Quantization_Normal_Return'Result then Before in 0 .. Scale and then After = Before and then abs (Long_Float (After) / Long_Float (Scale) - P) <= 0.51E-15)

(if P in 0.0 .. 1.0 and then Before in 0 .. Scale
       and then After = Before and then
       abs (Long_Float (After) / Long_Float (Scale) - P) <= 0.51E-15 then Quantization_Normal_Return'Result)

(if Sqrt_Normal_Return'Result then (if X >= 1.0E-30 then Y >= 1.0E-15) and then (if X >= 0.0625 then Y >= 0.25) and then (if X >= 1.0 then Y >= 1.0) and then (if X <= 1.0 then Y <= 1.0) and then (if X <= 4.0 then Y <= 2.0) and then (if X <= 64.0 then Y <= 8.0))

(if Y in 0.0 .. 1.0E3
       and then (if X >= 1.0E-30 then Y >= 1.0E-15)
       and then (if X >= 0.0625 then Y >= 0.25)
       and then (if X >= 1.0 then Y >= 1.0)
       and then (if X <= 1.0 then Y <= 1.0)
       and then (if X <= 4.0 then Y <= 2.0)
       and then (if X <= 64.0 then Y <= 8.0) then Sqrt_Normal_Return'Result)
(if Survival_Normal_Return'Result then (if Z >= 10.0 then P < 1.0E-20) and then (if Z <= -10.0 then P > 1.0 - 1.0E-14))

(if P in 0.0 .. 1.0
       and then (if Z >= 10.0 then P < 1.0E-20)
       and then (if Z <= -10.0 then P > 1.0 - 1.0E-14) then Survival_Normal_Return'Result)
(if Union_Normal_Return'Result then B in 0 .. Scale and then J in 0 .. Scale and then A = Old_A and then B = Old_B and then J = Old_J and then J <= A and then J <= B and then A + B <= Scale)

(if A in 0 .. Scale and then B in 0 .. Scale and then J in 0 .. Scale
       and then A = Old_A and then B = Old_B and then J = Old_J
       and then J <= A and then J <= B and then A + B <= Scale then Union_Normal_Return'Result)
((for all K in Case_Index => Admission_Core.Total (Data.Simulation (K).Cells) = Trials))
((for all K in Case_Index => Data.Simulation (K).Marginal_A = Admission_Core.Marginal_A (Data.Simulation (K).Cells)))
((for all K in Case_Index => Data.Simulation (K).Marginal_B = Admission_Core.Marginal_B (Data.Simulation (K).Cells)))
for all K in Case_Index => Total (Tallies (K)) = Iteration - 1
(for all K in Case_Index => Total (Tallies (K)) = Iteration)
(for all K in Case_Index => Tallies (K).N11 <= Iteration)
(Tallies => (Tallies, X, Y, A, B), null => Iteration)
(for all K in Towers_Engine.Case_Index => Admission_Core.Total (Data.Simulation (K).Cells) = Trials)
(for all K in Towers_Engine.Case_Index => Data.Simulation (K).Marginal_A = Admission_Core.Marginal_A (Data.Simulation (K).Cells))
(for all K in Towers_Engine.Case_Index => Data.Simulation (K).Marginal_B = Admission_Core.Marginal_B (Data.Simulation (K).Cells))
(if Case_Name_Agrees'Result and then Text'Length = Case_Name (K)'Length then Text = Case_Name (K))
(Text (Text'First) in '0' .. '9' or else (Text (Text'First) = '-' and then Text'Length > 1))
(for some C of Text => C in '0' .. '9')
(if Kind in Calculations | Simulation then Data_Row_Count'Result = 4)

(if Integer_Field'Result then (Text (Text'First) in '0' .. '9' or else
                 (Text (Text'First) = '-' and then Text'Length > 1)) and then (for all I in Text'Range =>
          (if I /= Text'First then Text (I) in '0' .. '9')))

(if Text'Length > 0
       and then (Text (Text'First) in '0' .. '9' or else
                 (Text (Text'First) = '-' and then Text'Length > 1))
       and then (for all I in Text'Range =>
          (if I /= Text'First then Text (I) in '0' .. '9')) then Integer_Field'Result)
(not Decimal_Input (Text, Limit).Recognized or else Actual = Decimal_Input (Text, Limit).Value)

(Option_Agrees'Result = (Actual in 0 .. Limit and then
          (if Decimal_Input (Text, Limit).Recognized then Actual = Decimal_Input (Text, Limit).Value)))

(if Real_Field'Result then (for all C of Text => C in '0' .. '9' or C = '.'
                   or C = 'E' or C = 'e' or C = '+' or C = '-') and then (for some C of Text => C in '0' .. '9'))

(if Text'Length > 0
       and then (for all C of Text => C in '0' .. '9' or C = '.'
                   or C = 'E' or C = 'e' or C = '+' or C = '-')
       and then (for some C of Text => C in '0' .. '9') then Real_Field'Result)

(if Report_Valid'Result then Valid_Seed (Seed) and then (for all K in Towers_Engine.Case_Index =>
          Admission_Core.Total (Data.Simulation (K).Cells) = Trials))

(if Valid_Trials (Trials) and then Valid_Seed (Seed)
       and then (for all K in Towers_Engine.Case_Index =>
          Admission_Core.Total (Data.Simulation (K).Cells) = Trials) then Report_Valid'Result)
